lines.3: 「Yoshimi, saying that won't make it happen.」
lines.4: 「Everyone's laughing at me... My tiny little scrap of pride is in tatters.」
lines.5: 「I guess a clown can't complain when people laugh at him.」
lines.6: 「You know what Ellie's personality is like.」
lines.9: 「Not being good enough for the Princess makes me feel so small.」
lines.10: 「It kills me how weak I am, how little I have to offer...!」
lines.11: 「But that's what I get for coasting through an ordinary life. And I hate myself for it!」
lines.14: 「I'm not just trying to console you!」
lines.18: 「Someone who knows your good points and fell for you is standing right here!」
lines.19: 「So... please don't say you hate yourself...」
lines.26: 「I-I finally blurted it out in the heat of the moment!」
lines.27: Yoshimi's cheeks turned redder than the sunset.
lines.30: Too embarrassed to speak, she nodded with all her might.
lines.31: 「I thought you only went for the Princess.」
lines.32: 「That's a completely different kind of love!」
lines.33: 「Oh, sorry. I wasn't trying to make fun of you.」
lines.34: 「Th-This is so embarrassing... G-Give me a second. I need to breathe.」
lines.35: Yoshimi haltingly tried to gather her words.
lines.36: Her innocent awkwardness looked irresistibly sweet.
lines.38: 「Maybe it's unfair to say this right after Ellie broke your heart,」
lines.39: 「but I want to help you feel better!」
lines.40: 「I don't shine the way Ellie does,」
lines.41: 「b-but I can at least cheer up the boy I love.」
lines.46: An electric shock tore through my adversity-addled brain.
lines.47: I mean, why in the world would Yoshimi like yours truly?! It wasn't as if we'd made some childhood promise.
lines.48: Or I'd saved her from a thug or a vicious dog.
lines.49: We didn't have a single episode like that between us.
lines.52: Yoshimi braced herself with a determined jerk.
lines.53: But her whole body was trembling with nerves.
lines.55: 「What is it... that you like about me?」
lines.57: But I hated myself right then. I needed to hear the answer.
lines.58: 「Um, w-which part should I start with?」
lines.61: 「You're always considerate of everyone around you. You hold yourself back and let other people have the spotlight.」
lines.62: 「People who can't think about anyone else are scary... to me.」
lines.63: 「And even though you usually keep yourself in check, when it really matters you're brave and manly and so cool!」
lines.65: 「You get fired up over someone insulting your friends, even when you let insults against yourself slide.」
lines.66: 「You're kind to people who are weaker than you.」
lines.67: 「You don't lie without a good reason.」
lines.69: I had recovered quite a bit already.
lines.70: Wow. I sounded like a pretty great guy.
lines.71: 「And then... well... this is a little shallow, but...」
lines.72: 「Your face is pretty much exactly my type. Ahaha.」
lines.74: This wasn't empty consolation or some joke!
lines.75: These were the words of someone who had truly been watching me all along.
lines.76: Come to think of it, Yoshimi really had always been kind to me.
lines.77: She was kind to everyone, so I'd made sure not to get the wrong idea.
lines.78: But it had been real after all.
lines.80: 「So if you went out with me, Tsushima... I think I'd be really happy...」
lines.82: A surprise confession like this was practically cheating.
lines.83: But as a man, I had to give her an answer.
